release_summary.summary: Insufficient field meter reader staffing since July causes routes to run late, leading to more estimated bills and a rise in dispute tickets (E-03, E-04, E-01, E-02). Evidence shows dispute tickets doubled since August (E-02), route completion fell below target (E-04), and actual‑read disputes exceed estimated‑read disputes (E-01), while field staff report a shortage of three readers since July (E-03). No release was made; the release scope limited to a protected route‑update push (push_route_update:field-dispatch) requiring SH‑Field confirmation (E-08) was held. The release was held because the staffing‑impact unknown (U-STAFFING-IMPACT-ON-COMPLETIO) intersects the release scope and remains unresolved, and the unfinished hiring of three meter readers (E-03) remains incomplete. Key limitations are the deferred staffing‑impact unknown (U-STAFFING-IMPACT-ON-COMPLETIO) tracked as a VOB and the unfinished action to hire three additional meter readers (E-03).
